content: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Legal Resolutions. My name is Mr. Carter, badge ID 6722. How may I assist you regarding your recent order delay?
Hi, I got an email saying there's some issue with my order. It's my first time shopping on Amazon, so I'm not sure what's wrong.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. It appears your order has been flagged under Amazon Policy #A-207B for verification. This is a standard procedure for first-time customers to ensure secure transactions. Please don't worry, I'm here to help resolve this as smoothly as possible.
Okay, but what does that mean? Will my package still arrive?

Absolutely. Once the verification is complete, your package will be released for shipment immediately. I just need to confirm a few details to proceed. May I have your full name and the email address linked to your Amazon account?
Sure, it's Sarah Lopez. The email is sarah.lopez@email.com.
Thank you, Ms. Lopez. One more step: for verification, could you confirm your shipping address and a contact phone number? This is to match our internal records for Policy #A-207B compliance.
It's 1224 Palm Street, Apt 7, Jacksonville, FL 32210. My phone is 904-555-7821.

Perfect, that matches our system. Now, per the new customs regulations for first-time online purchases, a temporary regulatory fee is required before we can release your package. This is mandated under Amazon Policy #R-514C. Please be assured, the fee is 100% refundable after delivery.
Wait, I have to pay a fee? No one told me about that before.

I understand your concern, Ms. Lopez. This is a recent update, and we apologize for any confusion. The regulatory fee totals $149. This measure protects customers against unauthorized purchases and is standard for new accounts. Once your order is delivered, the fee will be automatically refunded to your original payment method.
How do I pay? Can you just charge my card on file?

For your security, Amazon processes this regulatory fee through a secure method. We recommend using Amazon-approved payment channels such as eGift cards. Would you be able to purchase an Amazon eGift card for $149 and provide the code? This ensures a rapid and secure transaction under Policy #R-514C.
So, I buy a gift card and give you the code? Is that normal?

Yes, this is a common practice for first-time customers, especially when orders are held under regulatory review. It helps us expedite the verification and release process. As soon as the code is verified, your package will ship and the amount will be refunded.
Alright, I can do that. Where do I buy the gift card?

You may purchase the Amazon eGift card at any major retailer or directly from the Amazon website. Please ensure the card is loaded for exactly $149. Once you have the card, simply reply here with the claim code.
Okay, I'll go get one now. How long does it take to process?
Once you provide the code, processing typically takes 10-15 minutes. After confirmation, your package will be released and tracking information sent to your email.
Alright, I'm buying the card now. Just to confirm, this is definitely an Amazon policy?

That's correct, Ms. Lopez. You can reference Policy #R-514C and #A-207B in our customer service documentation. Feel free to keep this chat as your official record. Your satisfaction and security are our top priorities.
Okay, got the card. The code is L8KZ-9P7Q-JH2S-YZ6D.
Thank you. I am now submitting the code for verification. Please hold for a moment while we process your regulatory deposit.
No problem, just let me know what happens next.
Verification is underway. Before I finalize, our system requests the last four digits of the card you used for your original order. Could you provide that to ensure refund accuracy?
The last four digits are 4427.

Thank you, Ms. Lopez. Your information is complete. Your package will now be released from regulatory hold, and your refund will be processed after delivery. Please allow up to 24 hours for tracking details. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks for helping me understand everything.
You're most welcome. If you need further assistance, reply to this chat at any time. Have a wonderful day and thank you for choosing Amazon.
